# Contributing to AI Prompt Templates

Thank you for your interest in contributing!

## How to Contribute

### Report Issues

- Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Hardonian/ai-prompt-templates/issues) for bug reports or template issues
- Include which AI model you tested with and the output you received

### Suggest New Templates

- Open an issue with the "template-request" label
- Describe the use case and expected output

### Submit Templates

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a feature branch: `git checkout -b my-new-template`
3. Add your template to the appropriate category file
4. Follow the template format (see below)
5. Submit a pull request

## Template Format

Each template must include:

```
### Template Name

**Template:**
[The prompt text with [VARIABLES] in brackets]

**Variables:**
- [VARIABLE_1]: Description of what to put here
- [VARIABLE_2]: Description of what to put here

**Example:**
[Filled-in example showing real usage]

**Tips:**
- Tip for better results
- Tip for customization
```

## Template Guidelines

- Test with at least 2 different AI models
- Include realistic examples
- Make variables clear and specific
- Keep templates focused on one task
- Add tips for common pitfalls
